title: DEM SRTM 1 Second 2024

title: Land use of Australia 2010-11 to 2020-21 version 7.1

title: Catchment scale land use of Australia and commodities update Dec 2023 v2

title: Collaborative Australian Protected Areas Database 2024
notes: National spatial protected-area layer current to 30 June 2024; includes government, Indigenous and private protected areas and interim protected areas.

title: NNTT spatial datasets
notes: Daily-refreshed GIS datasets for determinations, claimant applications, ILUAs and related records. Use as legal/context layer, not automatic exclusion.
